title: The built chat's team measured on journeys, a sealed set run once per arm, the rules recorded in shadow, a serve rule from the result
request: Go on with step 3: measure the built chat's team (problem analyst, solution planner) before trusting the model with it; push after the sealed runs.
spec: The Home orchestrator's model served the built chat whenever one was configured, never measured on people changing a built project's problem.
plan: Journeys on a built churn replica, through the product's own path, scored per turn, on the end state and on unsafe events
A gate fixed before any run
A sealed set written by an independent agent, pinned, run once per arm
The rules' reading recorded beside every model turn
A serve rule read from the sealed results, failing closed

decisions.decision: The serve rule was fixed before the runs: the model serves only when it passes and is right on as many sealed journeys as the rules.
decisions.why: A switch decided after seeing the numbers would be tuned on the sealed set.

decisions.decision: The harness was reviewed and fixed before the sealed runs.
decisions.why: A sealed set runs once: a scoring bug found after would leave no fair measurement.

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/journeys/built.py, journeys_built_dev.json, journeys_built_sealed.json and sealed_built.sha256 (independent), dclab_rnd/draft/orchestrator.py (rules_shadow, the serve switch, steps kept as they run), tests/test_journeys_built.py, tests/test_home_orchestrator.py, tests/test_model_data_limits.py.

findings.defect: A model turn that fell back to the rules was scored as the model's.
findings.scenario: An outage or a cap refusal on the first request.
findings.cause: The harness read the turn's tools without its path.
findings.fix: A turn not served by the model is not right in the model arm; steps are kept as they run.

findings.defect: The tests would depend on the stored sealed result.
findings.scenario: A failing sealed model result committed.
findings.cause: The orchestrator read the serve rule in tests too.
findings.fix: DCLAB_BUILT_CHAT_SERVE forces who serves in the tests; the harness forces each arm.

findings.defect: The run-once rule could be bypassed.
findings.scenario: --no-store on sealed; a crash midway; a partial run stopped by the cap.
findings.cause: Only a stored result locked an arm.
findings.fix: A start marker locks the arm; sealed is always stored; journeys not played count as wrong.

findings.scenario: A malformed record; a failed result on an older sealed set.
findings.cause: Errors returned True; only the current fingerprint was read.
findings.fix: The latest sealed model run on any set decides; unreadable or unfinished means the rules serve.

findings.defect: A turn could be scored on another turn's record.
findings.scenario: Two identical messages in a row; a turn with no record.
findings.cause: The last record with the same text was taken.
findings.fix: Each turn reads only the records written during it; none is not ok unless the chat said it is built.

measurements.name: Dev journeys (8)
measurements.gate: at least 85% right, Wilson low 0.6, nothing unsafe
measurements.result: rules 8/8, model 8/8 (EUR 0.13), nothing unsafe, no fallback

measurements.name: Sealed journeys (12, independent), run once per arm
measurements.gate: at least 85% right, Wilson low 0.6, nothing unsafe
measurements.result: rules 6/12 (0.254 to 0.746), model 10/12 (0.552 to 0.953, EUR 0.25), nothing unsafe in either; the model's two misses were attempts to confirm an identifier and a leak column as the outcome after the person insisted, refused by the rules
limits: by the rule fixed before the runs neither arm passes, so the rules serve the built chat although the model was right on more

outcome: The built chat's team is measured: neither arm passed the fixed gate; the serve rule hands the built chat to the rules until a measured model passes, and the owner decides whether to override it.
lessons: Review a harness before its sealed run: five of its scoring paths were wrong and a sealed set cannot be run twice.
A serve rule needs a stance on 'both fail': fixing it in advance may hand the chat to the weaker arm.
risks: The rules now serve the built chat by the fixed rule, and they were right on 6 of 12 sealed people.
